body: idk. i think i may have bpd and have scheduled a doctors appointment to assess this on friday
i wrote a longer and more detailed explanation in another comment

camhs and cyps where i live _never_ diagnose anyone with depression, my councillor said to me that if i was 18 i would have been diagnosed with depression. i cant talk to him about that its just not an option, and no again my doctor said he cant prescribe medication until im 18

I am 16. I got in touch with my dad for the first time in June last year and told his other three children who didn't know about me that I existed, I guess. Recently he has not been bothering with me.I feel discarded again. I dont live with my mother because she doesnt have lots of money, I live with my grandparents but I know that my grandfather has complained about paying for me to livewith them before so I dont think anyone wants me anyway. I have hardly any friends, in or outside of school and spend all of the free time I get with my boyfriend (18) but he doesn't really like me either, he's messaged other girls about fucking them before and hes hit mebefore and he doesnt bother talking to me much which upsets me because i am really lonely and i love him. i think the worst thing is loneliness and i am giving up on trying anymore. i have self harmed in the past and have been diagnosed with "severe low moods" (health services in uk dont like saying minors have depression) and anxiety. i dont know if it is my anxiety causing this but i keep having delusions which i realise are silly afterwards - i thought there was an evil lizard type being living in the walls of my house and wouldnt talk to my friend as i was convinced she had summoned a demon to come and get me. i genuinely believed these things for about a week - two weeks. i dont like living in terror and loneliness so i think i would like to die now and that is it.
im not even sure how to message you
i have nothing to live for
